name: coteditor-win-devtools
description: Dev tooling for CotEditor-win (smoke tests). The actual frontend lives in frontend/.

scripts.regression: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');const base='http://127.0.0.1:1420/';const steps=[{name:'smoke:browser',command:'npm run smoke:browser',file:null},{name:'documents',command:'node scripts/regression-documents.mjs '+base,file:'scripts/regression-documents.mjs'},{name:'editing',command:'node scripts/regression-editing.mjs '+base,file:'scripts/regression-editing.mjs'},{name:'chrome',command:'node scripts/regression-chrome.mjs '+base,file:'scripts/regression-chrome.mjs'},{name:'highlighting',command:'node scripts/regression-highlighting.mjs '+base,file:'scripts/regression-highlighting.mjs'},{name:'preview-main',command:'node scripts/regression-preview-main.mjs '+base,file:'scripts/regression-preview-main.mjs'},{name:'find-main',command:'node scripts/regression-find-main.mjs '+base,file:'scripts/regression-find-main.mjs'},{name:'a11y',command:'node scripts/regression-a11y.mjs '+base,file:'scripts/regression-a11y.mjs'}];const missing=steps.filter(s=>s.file&&!fs.existsSync(s.file));if(missing.length){console.error('regression: missing required suite script(s): '+missing.map(s=>s.file).join(', '));console.error('regression: nothing was run; create the missing suite(s) instead of skipping them.');process.exit(1)}for(const step of steps){console.log('');console.log('[regression] '+step.name+': '+step.command);const result=cp.spawnSync(step.command,{stdio:'inherit',shell:true});if(result.error){console.error('[regression] '+step.name+' could not start: '+result.error.message);process.exit(1)}if(result.status!==0){console.error('[regression] '+step.name+' failed with exit code '+result.status);process.exit(result.status||1)}}console.log('');console.log('[regression] all suites passed')"
